business_summary: MonotaRO Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates an online MRO products store for factories in Japan and internationally. It offers safety protective equipment, work clothes, and safety shoes; logistics, storage, and packing supplies; tapes; safety, disaster prevention, and crime prevention products; safety signs; office supplies; office furniture/lighting/cleaning supplies; cutting tools and abrasives; measurement and surveying equipment; work tools/electric and pneumatic tools; sprays, oils, greases, and paints; adhesives and repair materials; welding supplies; and plumbing, plumbing members, pumps, pneumatics, hydraulic equipment, and hoses. It also provides mechanical parts; control equipment; soldering/static countermeasure products; building hardware and materials; painting and interior supplies; air conditioning and electrical equipment; electrical materials; screws, bolts, nails, and materials; automotive, truck, motorcycle, and bicycle supplies; scientific research and development supplies; clean room supplies; kitchen equipment and store supplies; agricultural materials and gardening supplies; and medical and nursing care supplies. The company was formerly known as Sumisho Grainger Co., Ltd. and changed its name to MonotaRO Co., Ltd. in February 2006. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Kita, Japan. MonotaRO Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Grainger Global Holdings, Inc.
business_summary_ko: MonotaRO Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 일본 및 해외 공장을 위한 온라인 MRO 제품 매장을 운영하고 있습니다. 안전 보호 장비, 작업복, 안전화를 제공합니다. 물류, 보관, 포장 용품; 테이프; 안전, 방재, 범죄 예방 제품; 안전표지; 사무용품; 사무용 가구/조명/청소 용품; 절삭 공구 및 연마재; 측정 및 측량 장비; 작업 도구/전기 및 공압 도구; 스프레이, 오일, 그리스, 페인트; 접착제 및 수리 재료; 용접용품; 배관, 배관 부재, 펌프, 공압 장치, 유압 장비 및 호스. 또한 기계 부품도 제공합니다. 제어 장비; 납땜/정전기 대책 제품; 건축 하드웨어 및 재료; 회화 및 인테리어 용품; 에어컨 및 전기 장비; 전기재료; 나사, 볼트, 못, 재료; 자동차, 트럭, 오토바이 및 자전거 용품; 과학 연구 및 개발 용품; 클린룸 용품; 주방 장비 및 매장 용품; 농업 자재 및 원예 용품; 의료 및 간호 용품. 회사는 이전에 kno였습니다.
